posts.author: Fallen
posts.title: The Syndicate (Revival)
posts.edited: Last Edit: April 05, 2009, 04:02:47 PM by Fallen
posts.html:
Well after my break , i have decided the syndicate should come back in full force too.
Any original members are free to join.

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/TheSyndicategroup

We are a group of Close members who hope to attain trust and security within each other.
and a strong set of rules within our group.we stick up for each other and are prepared to risk lots to
help out.anyone who stands against us will be crushed.
we are not against any groups atm, it should stay this way. hoping to talk to S9 to talk about allies

Ok, to apply here is the guideline.

either catch Me,Vautaut, or sniper ingame and we will put you on trial.
we can deny you access if you are not to be trusted.
if you wish to apply here on the forums.

follow this questionaire:

1.Killing People is Fun , and so is car killing!    True/False
2.If someone kills me , im going to go back and get revenge  True/false
3.I just joined the game - I have read the ingame rules by pressing f1 ( i have also read the mayors laws)  True/False
4.I accept that admins can stop roleplay situations if they go out of hand   True/False.
5.I accept that I must do what syndicate Dons and the godfather tells me.  True/false.
6.I am in, Or have been in a group called the Royals True/False


RANKINGS
1.Initiate
You are currently on the testing team , to see if you can qualify to get on the team. you will be allowed in on don and godfather decision

2.Mobster
the lowest form of recruit. you just got in the syndicate. and know nothing about who or what the leaders plans are. you have respect and
you are still on trial.

3.Comrade.
You have been in The Syndicate quite a while and people trust you. you are sometimes given charge of the lower recruits.

4.Don
You are now the second in command of the syndicate.
there can be up to 4 dons. you have charge of initiates, mobsters,comrades.
in the event the godfather is not around - you are in leadership.

5.The Godfather
The owner and found of the syndicate. the godfather does not have absolute power- with a 2/3's vote from the dons and comrades
a mutiny can throw him out of the syndicate, to show a true democratic state.
he has the ability to make decisions and orders on behalf of the syndicate. it is the groups task to protect him and make his orders happen.
